login.title: Welcome back
login.subtitle: Log in to pick up where you left off.

register.title: Create your account
register.subtitle: Email and password — that's all. Your progress will be with you on any device.

forgot.title: Forgot password?
forgot.subtitle: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to reset your password.
forgot.sentText: If an account exists for {email}, we've sent a password reset link. Check your spam folder if you don't see it.

save.title: Save your progress
save.text: Right now your progress lives only on this device. Add Google or an email — your words, XP and rewards stay, and you can sign in on any device.
save.savedText: Your account is ready. Sign in the same way on any other device — your words will be waiting.
save.takenTitle: You already have a Kolo account
save.takenGoogle: This Google account is already linked to Kolo. Sign in to it, and we'll add the sets from your trial. XP and rewards from the trial won't carry over.
save.takenEmail: {email} already has a Kolo account. Enter its password to sign in, and we'll add the sets from your trial. XP and rewards from the trial won't carry over.
save.movedText: The sets from your trial are now in your account, with their review schedule.

errors.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 6 characters
errors.emailInUse: This email is already in use
errors.tooManyRequests: Too many attempts. Try again later.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.trial: Couldn't start. Check your connection and try again.
